title: The Bean Harvest

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Do you remember planting the new bean row in the spring? Look at it now!

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: The pods are fat and ready. Five pods in each basket, please, so we can share them out.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Put five bean pods in each basket. Count as you go.
steps.hint: Find a basket with an empty dip, and put a pod there.

older.prompt: Five pods in each of five baskets. No dips to help: count in fives. How many in all?

feedback.full: That basket is full. Try the next one.
feedback.all_good: Four baskets of five: twenty pods, from one little row!

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Twenty pods from seeds you planted with your own hands. And inside each pod, more seeds for next year.

journal_line: I picked the bean harvest from the row I planted in spring.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Five baskets of five: twenty-five pods! What a harvest.
